browseNothingOnOffer: No food is on offer right now. Let's look again in a little while.
notFound: This page does not exist, or that kitchen has nothing on offer right now.
loadError: We couldn't load the food right now. Let's try again in a moment.
searchHint: Something hot, no meat, in Mohandessin
searchUnavailable: Search isn't working right now, but browsing what's on offer works as usual.
searchIsOff: Search is off. It can be turned back on in Settings at any time, and browsing what's on offer works as usual.
searchFoundNothing: We didn't find anything like that. Here's everything on offer right now.
searchExclusionNotUnderstood: We understood that something was to be left out, but not what it was — so no Meal was removed on account of it. Let's try the name of the food on its own.
searchFilteredOn: We removed Meals listed as containing {food}. That's based on what Cooks wrote and the AI Assistant's estimate — it does not mean the rest have no {food} in them.
searchAreaEmpty: There's no food on offer in {area} right now.
searchAreaChoose: There is food in these areas, though. Kafoo doesn't know how far apart areas are, and delivery is a matter between the Customer and the Cook.
searchAreasUnknown: We can't work out which areas have food right now. Let's try again in a moment.
searchConsentQuestion: For Kafoo to understand the words and find the right food, what was typed into search has to go to a service outside Kafoo. Kafoo itself does not record these words or keep them. Shall we send it?
searchConsentNote: If the answer is no, search won't work and browsing what's on offer carries on. The answer will be kept in this browser only, and can be changed in Settings at any time.
searchJudgementNothingAnswers: Nothing here is exactly what you asked for.
searchJudgementAlternativesOne: Nothing here is exactly what you asked for. Among what's on offer right now: «{first}»
searchJudgementAlternativesTwo: Nothing here is exactly what you asked for. Among what's on offer right now: «{first}» and «{second}»
searchJudgementAlternativesThree: Nothing here is exactly what you asked for. Among what's on offer right now: «{first}», «{second}» and «{third}»
settingsSearchExplanation: To find the food being asked for, the words typed into search go to a service outside Kafoo that works out what they mean. With this off, search will not work, and browsing what's on offer carries on unchanged.
settingsSearchStorageNote: This answer is kept in this browser only. Kafoo does not record the words typed into search, and does not keep the answer either.
